name: The Hunting Grounds
intro: The arrow you drew in the blind hums, and the Edge of Chaos is gone. You stand at the edge of the old hunting grounds, where the guild's first rangers tracked the last wyverns — and one is still here.

rooms.name: The Hunting Grounds - The Bramble Run
rooms.description: A run of thorn and briar so thick it closes overhead. Something large has pushed through here recently. North, a fallen trunk blocks the way to the scree.

rooms.name: The Hunting Grounds - The Wyvern's Scree
rooms.description: A slope of loose stone streaked with old venom-burns. Broken eggshells crunch underfoot. North, a wall of thorns hides the nest.

rooms.name: The Hunting Grounds - The Nest
rooms.description: A crown of rock open to the sky, ringed with bones, and in the middle of it the biggest nest you have ever seen. It is not empty.

waves.text: Thorn-stalkers come out of the briars, low and fast!
More stalkers come down the scree, and a hatchling screams!
The eggs on the scree hatch all at once!

gates.text: You haul yourself over the fallen trunk — the scree lies ahead.
The thorn wall parts. The nest is above you, and something in it is moving.

boss.text: Gloomfang rises from her nest of bones, one huge eye fixed on you. She has seen a thousand hunters. She has eaten most of them.
